chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no harm in delaying the visitation of the House until the Day of Nafr; only the hastening of that is recommended, out of fear of incidents and obstructions.

key_terms.يَوْمِ النَّفْرِ: Day of Nafr (13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the visitation circumambulation of the Kaaba until after the Day of Nafr in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the preference for early Tawaf al-Ziyarah is merely recommended (mustahabb) rather than obligatory, primarily to avoid the practical difficulties of crowds and travel delays. This flexibility allows pilgrims to prioritize other essential rites, such as standing at Arafat, without compromising the validity of their Hajj. It reflects the Shia juristic principle of distinguishing between core obligations and recommended acts to facilitate worship.
